name: Example Training + Nutrition Plan
source_note: Example plan shipped with the repo so the engine runs out of the box. Every rule below is deterministic and quotable; swap in your own JSON to use it for real.

guardrails.source: Example Plan / Quick Rule 13: hoops energy, sleep, or swing quality drop -> eat a bit more; Tracking specifies 100-150 more
guardrails.rule: Only a worsening status creates a new increase proposal; an unresolved status needs review, not automatic compounding.

progression.current_block: Current block: barbell row 3x5 at working weight; pull-ups 6 per round.

future_blocks.W12-13: Goblet squat 3x5 to 3x6 at working weight; pull-ups 7 per round.
future_blocks.W14-15: Split squats 3x8 to 3x10 at working weight; pull-ups 7 per round.
future_blocks.W16-17: Barbell row 3x5 to 3x6 at working weight; pull-ups 8 per round.

progression.source: Example Plan / Progression and Three Stop Rules

stall.step_one: Recheck portions honestly, including butter and oil; make no carb change yet.
stall.step_two: After the portion recheck is complete, reduce dinner carbs by about one-third. Stop there.

deload.rule: The engine surfaces stop conditions; it does not auto-apply a deload.

medical_disclaimer: This is deterministic plan-tracking software, not medical care. Medical flags pause automated adjustment suggestions. Seek qualified help for health concerns and urgent care for emergency symptoms.
